title: 第十二章：我查宗
lines: 许还山离开槐水村那天，七村百姓来送。
有人送干粮，有人送蓑衣，有人送银钱。
最后，他只收了阿青给的一片河鳞。
阿青说，若以后遇到干旱，把河鳞放进水里，它能借一场小雨。
姜照雪骑着一匹瘦马等在村口。
许还山道：“你的马为什么看起来也像欠债？”
“那我们算不算两个穷鬼查天下第一债院？”
两人刚走出十里，前方路边出现一座茶棚。
荒郊野岭，雨后泥路，茶棚却干净得不像话。
棚中坐着一个青衣男子。
男子看上去三十上下，面容温和，眉眼清雅，正在慢慢煮茶。
稳得像天地间所有风雨都与他无关。
姜照雪勒马的瞬间，脸色变了。
许还山注意到她的反应。
“他要杀我，站这儿也得死。他请喝茶，不喝白不喝。”
content_zh:
三日后。

    青岚宗山门外。

    云海翻涌，十二座悬山浮在半空，山与山之间以铁索相连。每一座悬山下，都垂着无数命灯。

    命灯像星辰。

    也像眼睛。

    许还山站在山脚，仰头看了很久。

    “这宗门挺有钱。”

    姜照雪道：“青岚宗是南荒边境最大的修行宗门，弟子三万，掌三条灵脉。”

    “欠债多吗？”

    姜照雪看他。

    “你现在看什么都像欠债？”

    许还山道：“不是像。”

    他眼底灰光微动。

    “是真欠。”

    青岚宗山门前排着长长的队伍。

    今日是外门收徒日。

    少年少女们背着包袱，满脸期待。有人从千里外赶来，有人是家族凑钱送上山的，有人跪在山门前，只求一个修仙机会。

    山门旁挂着一面巨大的铜镜。

    铜镜前，青岚宗执事高声道：

    “入我青岚，先签培育债契。”

    “宗门传你功法，供你灵食，赐你灵石，护你家族。将来你有所成，需以战功、灵石、寿元、命灯偿还。”

    “自愿者，上前按印。”

    许还山听得眉头一挑。

    “入门先借贷？”

    姜照雪道：“宗门培育债很常见。”

    “合理吗？”

    “看条款。”

    许还山走到一张契纸前，看了一眼。

    前几行写得漂亮。

    宗门助弟子修行，弟子回报宗门。

    后几行字极小。

    若弟子未能按期突破，则宗门有权抽取命灯余息，用以抵偿培育之费。

    许还山笑了。

    “这不叫收徒。”

    姜照雪问：“叫什么？”

    “放贷。”

    排在前方的一个瘦弱少年回头看了他一眼。

    少年脸色苍白，眼睛却很亮。

    “你也是来拜宗的？”

    许还山道：“不是。”

    少年疑惑。
content_en:
Three days later.

Outside the Qinglan Sect Mountain Gate.

The sea of ​​clouds surged, and twelve hanging mountains floated in the air, connected by iron cables.Under every hanging mountain, there are countless life lamps hanging.

The life lamp is like a star.

Also like eyes.

Xu Huanshan stood at the foot of the mountain and looked up for a long time.

"This sect is quite rich."

Jiang Zhaoxue said: "Qinglan Sect is the largest cultivation sect in the Southern Wilderness border. It has 30,000 disciples and controls three spiritual veins."

"Do you owe a lot of debt?"

Jiang Zhaoxue looked at him.

"Everything looks like a debt to you now?"

Xu Huanshan said: "It's not a statue."

The gray light in his eyes moved slightly.

"I really owe it."

There was a long queue in front of the Qinglan Sect Mountain Gate.

Today is the day for the outsiders to accept disciples.

The boys and girls carried their burdens and looked forward to it.Some people came from thousands of miles away, some were sent to the mountain by their families, and some were kneeling in front of the mountain gate, just asking for a chance to cultivate immortality.

A huge bronze mirror hangs next to the mountain gate.

In front of the bronze mirror, the deacon of Qinglan Sect said loudly:

"When you join me, Qinglan, you must first sign a nurturing debt contract."

"The sect teaches you the skills, provides you with spiritual food, gives you spiritual stones, and protects your family. If you achieve anything in the future, you need to repay it with military exploits, spiritual stones, longevity, and life lamps."

"Anyone who volunteers, come forward and press the seal."

Xu Huanshan raised his eyebrows when he heard this.

“Getting started with a loan first?”

Jiang Zhaoxue said: "Sect cultivation debt is very common."

"Is it reasonable?"

"See the terms."

Xu Huanshan walked to a piece of deed paper and took a look at it.

The first few lines are beautifully written.

The sect helps its disciples practice, and the disciples repay the sect.

The last few lines are extremely small.

If the disciple fails to break through on time, the sect has the right to draw the remaining interest from the life lamp to pay for the training expenses.

Xu Huanshan smiled.

"This is not called accepting a disciple."

Jiang Zhaoxue asked: "What is it called?"

"Lending."

A thin young man in the front looked back at him.

The young man's face was pale, but his eyes were bright.

"Are you also here to pay homage to the clan?"

Xu Huanshan said: "No."

The young man was confused.
